name: Build your first FPS Level
author: limaCAT
description: I have made several add-ons for the "Build your first FPS Level" live course, such as a door that can be opened with three keys, colored keys, monsters that can drop said keys and a monster that can be killed only by the new weapon. Unfortunately I have a problem with the WebGL export and I could not find the proper settings to avoid make eveything look like a maze of mirrors :(.
